description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4330013818024 FILTER ELEMENT,FLUI: Line 0001 Qty 192 UI BX Deliver To: By: 0042 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 28. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0K209 3EE1420; 0K209 3EE1420/EDGE TEK/BX-12EA. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
